body.p: One man was living in his house, his name was Gidalo [lit. dragonfly]. Gidalo was very rich. In the world, where he was living, nobody was that rich. Gidalo got tired of living in the middle world, he wanted to live in the upper world. Early in the morning he got up, he went searching for a bird. In the evening Gidalo came home, he brought a bird. The bird said: "Store up food, clothes, water and wood for three years". Gidalo called all men and said: "Build up a balagan on the bird". The men built a balagan on the bird. They put everything into the balagan, what he had ordered to bring. Gidalo entered the balagan. The bird flew off. Gidalow was flying for a long time. Gidalo grew tired. On one day the bird stopped, it said: "We have arrived". They stopped. Gidalo was happy, quickly he ran out, he looked around, nobody is there, only a ladder is there bound upward. The bird said: "Climb up this ladder". The man climbed out the ladder. For a long time he was climbing through a small hole. It is dark there, suddenly light shone [from] above. Gidalo was happy saying "I have arrived", having climbed [out], he looked around, he saw a smoking tent. The man went to the yurt, he reached the yurt and went in, he saw, a woman, a man and a girl are living there. When Gidalo asked [something], they said: "The fire is crackling". Gidalo hadn't eat since the morning, he wanted to eat. He saw, at the crockery place meat is lying, he asked for eating meat. They said: "The fire is crackling". Gidalo took some meat, he ate his fill, he thought: "They don't see me". He wanted to play around, he tickled the girl in her armpit. The girl got mad. Her father went after the shaman. The shaman came, he started shamanizing, he saw nothing. The sick one got worse, her father went again, he went after a bigger shaman. He brought the shaman on reindeer. The shaman entered the tent, he saw the man sitting in the tent and said: "This is the one who makes [her] ill". It turned evening, the time of the sÃ©ance, they made the shaman shamanize. The shaman didn't shamanize, he said: "Why should we(?) shamanize something what is visible?" The shaman asked Gidalo: "Where did you come from?" That one said: "I came from the middle world". The shaman said: "Go to your world". "I have forgotten which way I was going". "I'll bring [you]", the shaman said. They went off together. They came to the hole, the shaman said: "Go through the hole (?)". Gidalo went off, he came to [DCh]: Direct speech is strange; imperative morphology is lacking. the bird, he entered the balagan, he said to the bird: "Fly [me] home". The bird flow off, having flown long it reached the house. The bird said: "We have arrived". Gidalo went out off the balagan, he went home. He came to his house, [there] are his relatives. He told his relatives how he was going to the upper world.
